title: Sarasota Art Museum

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Fuel your child’s imagination this summer with Summer Camp at SAM, a dynamic laboratory where creativity knows no bounds. Designed for ages 7-13, our weekly camps invite young creators to see the world through a lens of curiosity and wonder. Guided by professional teaching artists, campers will express themselves through various media each day, from Drawing, Painting, and Ceramics to Mixed Media and Digital Arts. The Grand Finale: Camps conclude with the opportunity for students to showcase their own creations in SAM’s Community Gallery, allowing young artists to experience the pride of a professional exhibition. Join as a Sarasota Art Museum Member today to save on Summer Camp enrollment

services.name: School Tours
services.desc: Students & Teachers, Welcome to Sarasota Art Museum! Bring your students for a Museum visit, free of charge!Sarasota Art Museum’s school tour program is designed to integrate visual art into the classroom and enhance student literacy, critical thinking, observation, and communication skills through museum visits, and classroom resources. School tours introduce students to original works of contemporary art, a range of media and processes, and related vocabulary to broaden students’ understanding of artistic concepts, increase comprehension of visual vocabulary, develop art-making skills, and build student self-confidence and communication skills.
